description: Measured fast-near evaluator values for the 52-point validation set (20 interior, 16 face, 16 outside per configuration), one row per point with all six normalized field components; input is the exact-field reference fastnear_reference_52pt.csv
commit_note: clone base (branch repro/figures-20261108); the fast evaluator and the independent reference are both the final code in this commit

generator.self_test_result: PASS (5 points, deterministic; fast matches independent exact evaluator <1e-2)

determinism.note: two runs on this host are byte-identical; a local reproducer on fwk394 (commit 4366c69) produced the same bytes, consistent with the CPU pointwise evaluator being host-independent

notes: Values are the picBunch fast-near evaluator (picBunch::pbfast::shape_field) at unit cells, compared against the independent exact-field reference in fastnear_reference_52pt.csv. Face and outside regions reproduce the published tab:fast to <1% for all three configurations. The interior entries are below the published values because the evaluator (obaRayField oblique ray integral) and the reference (refined indfield) changed after publication; the change is largest for the g10-oblique interior, 8.15e-2 published to 1.94e-3 now. CPU-only: no alpaka, CUDA, or FFTW is linked.
